strengths: Dashboard uses branch-day pulse as the dominant landmark and places task/readiness cards before secondary context
Branch Day makes state and close blockers visually dominant and names Finance as independent checker
Financial pages are visibly read-only and explicitly name Front Office/Finance ownership without exposing references or client contact
Cash-Up separates immutable server-derived expected values from Branch-entered counted values and provides one dominant submit action
Empty states name the responsible role or next action instead of inventing filler metrics
Shared sidebar, tablet rail and mobile drawer retain branch context and exact canonical grouping
